description: Sub-Saharan Africa - Power Plants Locations is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Power system and utilities", published or maintained by Cecilia Briceño-Garmendia (World Bank Group). The Africa Infrastructure Country Diagnostic (AICD) was a knowledge program on Africa’s infrastructure that grew out of the pledge by the G8 Summit of 2005 at Gleneagles to substantially increase ODA assistance to Africa, particularly to the infrastructure sector, and the subsequent formation of the Infrastructure Consortium for Africa (ICA). Coverage: Sub-Saharan Africa. It has 2 files in GeoJSON, ZIP. The portal files it under Power system and utilities. The portal gives 2007 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
